# apple_scm_pull_requests (Data Source)

Lists the pull requests of a repository connected to Xcode Cloud, which `apple_start_ci_build_run` builds.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_scm_pull_requests" "all" {
  repository_id = data.apple_ci_products.app.products[0].primary_repository_id
}

output "open_pull_requests" {
  value = [for pr in data.apple_scm_pull_requests.all.pull_requests : pr.title if !pr.is_closed]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the repository; see `data.apple_scm_repositories`.

### Read-Only

- `pull_requests` (Attributes List) The pull requests. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pull_requests))

<a id="nestedatt--pull_requests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pull_requests`

Read-Only:

- `destination_branch_name` (String) Branch the pull request merges into.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the pull request.
- `is_closed` (Boolean) Whether the pull request is closed.
- `is_cross_repository` (Boolean) Whether the pull request comes from another repository, such as a fork.
- `number` (Number) Number of the pull request at the source control provider.
- `source_branch_name` (String) Branch the pull request comes from.
- `title` (String) Title of the pull request.
- `web_url` (String) URL of the pull request at the source control provider.
